links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid reading level of GPT-simplified reports versus original reports
links.effect: Reading level fell from 11.47 (SD 1.44) to 8.50 (SD 1.27), p < 0.001; word count unchanged (p = 0.510).
links.quote: With the base prompt, the average word count was not significantly changed (399.64 SD 72.70, p = 0.510) though the average reading level was significantly decreased to between 8 and 9th grade (8.50 SD 1.27, p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Reading grade level of patient-facing translations relative to original reports
links.effect: Mean grade level reduced from 11.47 to 8.50 with the base prompt, and 9.01 with the enhanced prompt. It remains at 8th-9th grade, above the commonly recommended level.
links.quote: With the base prompt, the average word count was not significantly changed (399.64 SD 72.70, p = 0.510) though the average reading level was significantly decreased to between 8 and 9th grade (8.50 SD 1.27, p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Omission and inaccuracy rates of GPT translations against radiology report by spine surgeon review
links.effect: Base prompt: 35% major omissions, 20% minor omissions, 6% major inaccuracies, 3% minor inaccuracies; mean Likert 3.48 (SD 1.56).
links.quote: Of the 93 reports reviewed, 35% had a major omission, 20% had a minor omission, 6% had a major inaccuracy, and 3% had a minor inaccuracy.

links.outcome: Errors in stenosis location, prior surgery description, and spine pathology in translations
links.effect: Even with enhanced prompting, errors remained: 3 omitted stenosis level, 4 prior-surgery errors, 3 inaccurate pathology descriptions.
links.quote: In analyzing the errors present in the enhanced prompt, three report translations failed to report the location of spinal stenosis (Table 4 ).

links.outcome: Frequency of clinically relevant omissions and inaccuracies in AI-simplified reports needing verification
links.effect: 34-35% of translations omitted a clinically relevant item and 6% had a clinically significant inaccuracy; only 36 of 93 had no errors.
links.quote: Of these 93 reports, 36 were indicated to have had no errors.

unlisted_practices: Few-shot prompting with high-scoring example translations to reduce omissions in radiology report simplification
